lore_anchors.definition: A set of spiritual beads that react to hostile supernatural entities with heat; used by Han Li as a passive early-warning system against illusions and ghostly threats.

A common xianxia trial trope where an environment or enemy manifests the form of a deceased loved one to test the cultivator’s emotional discipline; defeating it requires both recognition and a willingness to let go.
A thousand-year-old undead cultivator who sacrificed his reincarnation for vengeance; exists as a Profound Soul Body and plots against Extreme Yin from within his faction.
